analysis: Arithmetic Answering and Verification candidate-accuracy slopes

inference.condition: two-sided one-sample t-test of item-level alpha slopes
inference.framing_contrast: two-sided paired t-test of item-level alpha slopes
inference.zero_variance_rule: When every item-level slope is numerically zero, report estimate and CI as zero and p=1 instead of fitting a singular residual-variance model.
inference.multiplicity: No cross-model multiplicity adjustment; each model is a replication unit.
